entry.title: Make a moment for a song
entry.summary: Sing a familiar song or listen to a short piece together. Notice a look, a sound, or a movement that joins in.
entry.cue: Your baby is interested in your voice or the rhythm they hear.
detail: You can try the same song a little slower or with a different voice and see what holds their interest. A short rhyme with a familiar gesture is another possibility.
The authors make space for quiet between musical moments. Music need not run all day, and an instrument is not needed for sharing a song.
